    int taken = 0, i = 0;
    cin >> str;

        char c = str[i];
        if (c != 'a' && c != 'd') {
            ans.push_back(c);
            i++;
            continue;
        }
        if (c == 'a') {
            if (i == str.size() - 1 || str[i+1] != 't' || ans.empty() || taken) {
                ans.push_back('a');
                i++;
                continue;
            }
            taken = 1;
            ans.push_back('@');
            i += 2;
            continue;
        }
        // c == 'd'
        if (i >= str.size() - 3 || str[i+1] != 'o' || str[i+2] != 't' || ans.empty()) {
            ans.push_back('d');
            i++;
            continue;
        }
        ans.push_back('.');
        i += 3;
    }
    cout << ans;
    return 0;
}
